model.transformation.rpt_team_season_sta.name: rpt_team_season_stats
model.transformation.rpt_team_season_sta.description: Statistiques agrégées par équipe et par saison (saison régulière uniquement). Table clé pour les classements, tendances et cartes par état.
model.transformation.rpt_team_season_sta.rawCode:
with games as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_regular_season_games') }}
),
all_team_games as (
    select season, w_team_id as team_id, w_score as pts_scored, l_score as pts_allowed, 1 as is_win
    from games

    union all

    select season, l_team_id as team_id, l_score as pts_scored, w_score as pts_allowed, 0 as is_win
    from games
),
team_stats as (
    select
        season,
        team_id,
        count(*)                                            as games_played,
        sum(is_win)                                         as wins,
        count(*) - sum(is_win)                              as losses,
        round(sum(is_win)::double / count(*), 3)            as win_pct,
        round(avg(pts_scored), 1)                           as avg_pts_scored,
        round(avg(pts_allowed), 1)                          as avg_pts_allowed,
        round(avg(pts_scored - pts_allowed), 1)             as avg_pt_diff
    from all_team_games
    group by season, team_id
),
tourney_seeds as (
    select
        season,
        team_id,
        seed_number as tourney_seed_number,
        true        as made_tourney
    from {{ ref('stg_tourney_seeds') }}
),
teams as (
    select team_id, team_name, team_state, team_state_iso from {{ ref('dim_teams') }}
),
seasons as (
    select season, season_label from {{ ref('dim_seasons') }}
),
final as (
    select
        t.team_name,
        t.team_state,
        t.team_state_iso,
        ts.season,
        s.season_label,
        ts.games_played,
        ts.wins,
        ts.losses,
        ts.win_pct,
        ts.avg_pts_scored,
        ts.avg_pts_allowed,
        ts.avg_pt_diff,
        coalesce(seed.made_tourney, false)  as made_tourney,
        seed.tourney_seed_number
    from team_stats ts
    left join teams          t    on ts.team_id = t.team_id
    left join seasons        s    on ts.season  = s.season
    left join tourney_seeds  seed on ts.season  = seed.season and ts.team_id = seed.team_id
)
select * from final

model.transformation.dim_teams.name: dim_teams
model.transformation.dim_teams.description: Dimension équipes NCAA Women avec état d'origine déduit des matchs à domicile.
model.transformation.dim_teams.rawCode:
with teams as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_teams') }}
),
compact as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_regular_season_compact_results') }}
),
game_cities as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_game_cities') }}
),
cities as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_cities') }}
),
home_games as (
    select c.season, c.day_num, c.w_team_id as home_team_id, c.w_team_id, c.l_team_id
    from compact c
    where c.w_loc = 'H'

    union all

    select c.season, c.day_num, c.l_team_id as home_team_id, c.w_team_id, c.l_team_id
    from compact c
    where c.w_loc = 'A'
),
home_game_states as (
    select
        hg.home_team_id as team_id,
        ci.state
    from home_games hg
    inner join game_cities gc
        on  hg.season    = gc.season
        and hg.day_num   = gc.day_num
        and hg.w_team_id = gc.w_team_id
        and hg.l_team_id = gc.l_team_id
    inner join cities ci on gc.city_id = ci.city_id
),
team_state_ranked as (
    select
        team_id,
        state,
        count(*)       as cnt,
        row_number() over (partition by team_id order by count(*) desc) as rn
    from home_game_states
    group by team_id, state
),
team_states as (
    select
        team_id,
        state          as team_state,
        'US-' || state as team_state_iso
    from team_state_ranked
    where rn = 1
),
final as (
    select
        t.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        ts.team_state,
        ts.team_state_iso
    from teams t
    left join team_states ts on t.team_id = ts.team_id
)
select * from final

model.transformation.rpt_games.name: rpt_games
model.transformation.rpt_games.description: Tous les matchs (saison régulière + tournoi) dénormalisés avec noms d'équipes, ville hôte et analyse d'upsets. Une ligne par match, format gagnant/perdant. ~108k lignes. Pour une analyse centrée sur une équipe, préférer rpt_team_games.
model.transformation.rpt_games.rawCode:
with regular as (
    select
        game_id, game_type, season, game_date,
        w_team_id, l_team_id,
        w_score, l_score, score_margin,
        game_location, has_overtime, is_close_game,
        city_id,
        null::integer as w_seed_number,
        null::integer as l_seed_number,
        null::boolean as is_upset,
        null::integer as seed_difference
    from {{ ref('fct_regular_season_games') }}
),
tourney as (
    select
        game_id, game_type, season, game_date,
        w_team_id, l_team_id,
        w_score, l_score, score_margin,
        game_location, has_overtime, is_close_game,
        city_id,
        w_seed_number,
        l_seed_number,
        is_upset,
        seed_difference
    from {{ ref('fct_tourney_games') }}
),
all_games as (
    select * from regular
    union all
    select * from tourney
),
teams as (
    select team_id, team_name from {{ ref('dim_teams') }}
),
seasons as (
    select season, season_label from {{ ref('dim_seasons') }}
),
cities as (
    select city_id, city, state, 'US-' || state as state_iso from {{ ref('dim_cities') }}
),
final as (
    select
        g.game_id,
        g.game_type,
        g.season,
        s.season_label,
        g.game_date,
        wt.team_name                    as w_team_name,
        lt.team_name                    as l_team_name,
        g.w_score,
        g.l_score,
        g.score_margin,
        g.game_location,
        g.has_overtime,
        g.is_close_game,
        c.city,
        c.state,
        c.state_iso,
        g.w_seed_number,
        g.l_seed_number,
        g.is_upset,
        case
            when g.seed_difference >= 10  then 'Cinderella (10+ seeds)'
            when g.seed_difference >= 5   then 'Major Upset (5-9 seeds)'
            when g.seed_difference >= 1   then 'Upset (1-4 seeds)'
            when g.seed_difference = 0    then 'Same Seed'
            when g.seed_difference is null then null
            else                               'Expected Result'
        end                             as upset_label
    from all_games g
    left join teams   wt on g.w_team_id = wt.team_id
    left join teams   lt on g.l_team_id = lt.team_id
    left join seasons  s on g.season    = s.season
    left join cities   c on g.city_id   = c.city_id
)
select * from final

model.transformation.rpt_tourney_runs.name: rpt_tourney_runs
model.transformation.rpt_tourney_runs.description: Parcours au tournoi NCAA par équipe et saison. Permet d'analyser les champions, Cinderella stories et la performance par seed.
model.transformation.rpt_tourney_runs.rawCode:
with tourney_games as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_tourney_games') }}
),
all_tourney_team_games as (
    select season, w_team_id as team_id, 1 as is_win, w_score as pts_scored, l_score as pts_allowed
    from tourney_games

    union all

    select season, l_team_id as team_id, 0 as is_win, l_score as pts_scored, w_score as pts_allowed
    from tourney_games
),
team_tourney_stats as (
    select
        season,
        team_id,
        sum(is_win)                         as tourney_wins,
        count(*) - sum(is_win)              as tourney_losses,
        round(avg(pts_scored), 1)           as avg_pts_scored_tourney,
        round(avg(pts_allowed), 1)          as avg_pts_allowed_tourney
    from all_tourney_team_games
    group by season, team_id
),
seeds as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_tourney_seeds') }}
),
final as (
    select
        t.team_name,
        t.team_state,
        t.team_state_iso,
        tts.season,
        s.season_label,
        seed.seed_number,
        tts.tourney_wins,
        tts.tourney_losses,
        tts.avg_pts_scored_tourney,
        tts.avg_pts_allowed_tourney,
        tts.tourney_wins = 6            as is_champion,
        case tts.tourney_wins
            when 6 then 'Champion'
            when 5 then 'Runner-Up'
            when 4 then 'Final Four'
            when 3 then 'Elite Eight'
            when 2 then 'Sweet Sixteen'
            when 1 then 'Second Round'
            else        'First Round Exit'
        end                             as tournament_result
    from team_tourney_stats tts
    left join {{ ref('dim_teams') }}   t    on tts.team_id = t.team_id
    left join {{ ref('dim_seasons') }} s    on tts.season  = s.season
    left join seeds                    seed on tts.season  = seed.season and tts.team_id = seed.team_id
)
select * from final

),

),

    select
        season, day_num, game_type,
        w_team_id, l_team_id,
        w_score, l_score,
        game_location,
        has_box_score,
        w_fgm, w_fga, w_fgm3, w_fga3, w_ftm, w_fta,

    from regular

    select
        season, day_num, game_type,
        w_team_id, l_team_id,
        w_score, l_score,
        game_location,
        has_box_score,
        w_fgm, w_fga, w_fgm3, w_fga3, w_ftm, w_fta,
        w_reb, w_or, w_dr, w_ast, w_to, w_stl, w_blk, w_pf,
        l_fgm, l_fga, l_fgm3, l_fga3, l_ftm, l_fta,
        l_reb, l_or, l_dr, l_ast, l_to, l_stl, l_blk, l_pf
    from tourney
),
teams as (
    select team_id, team_name, team_state, team_state_iso from {{ ref('dim_teams') }}
),
seasons as (
    select season, season_label from {{ ref('dim_seasons') }}
),
tourney_seeds as (
    select season, team_id, seed_number as tourney_seed_number, true as made_tourney
    from {{ ref('stg_tourney_seeds') }}
),
-- Connecticut (3163) and Tennessee (3397)
rival_ids as (
    select team_id from teams where team_name in ('Connecticut', 'Tennessee')
),
-- Unpivot: one row per team per game (as winner or loser)
team_games as (
    select
        g.season,
        g.w_team_id                            as team_id,
        1                                      as is_win,
        g.w_score                              as pts_scored,
        g.l_score                              as pts_allowed,
        g.game_location,
        g.game_type,
        g.has_box_score,
        g.w_fgm                                as fgm,
        g.w_fga                                as fga,
        g.w_fgm3                               as fgm3,
        g.w_fga3                               as fga3,
        g.w_ftm                                as ftm,

        g.w_blk                                as blk,
        g.w_pf                                 as pf
    from all_games g
    where g.w_team_id in (select team_id from rival_ids)

    union all

    select
        g.season,
        g.l_team_id                            as team_id,
        0                                      as is_win,
        g.l_score                              as pts_scored,
        g.w_score                              as pts_allowed,
        case g.game_location
            when 'Home' then 'Away'
            when 'Away' then 'Home'
            else 'Neutral'
        end                                    as game_location,
        g.game_type,
        g.has_box_score,
        g.l_fgm                                as fgm,
        g.l_fga                                as fga,
        g.l_fgm3                               as fgm3,
        g.l_fga3                               as fga3,
        g.l_ftm                                as ftm,
        g.l_fta                                as fta,

        g.l_stl                                as stl,
        g.l_blk                                as blk,
        g.l_pf                                 as pf
    from all_games g
    where g.l_team_id in (select team_id from rival_ids)

        count(*)                                                            as games_played,
        sum(tg.is_win)                                                      as wins,
        count(*) - sum(tg.is_win)                                           as losses,
        round(sum(tg.is_win)::double / count(*), 3)                         as win_pct,
        sum(tg.pts_scored)                                                  as total_pts_scored,
        sum(tg.pts_allowed)                                                 as total_pts_allowed,
        round(avg(tg.pts_scored), 1)                                        as avg_pts_scored,
        round(avg(tg.pts_allowed), 1)                                       as avg_pts_allowed,
        round(avg(tg.pts_scored - tg.pts_allowed), 1)                       as avg_pt_diff,
        -- win rate by location
        count(case when tg.game_location = 'Home' then 1 end)              as home_games,
        sum(case when tg.game_location = 'Home' then tg.is_win else 0 end) as home_wins,

model.transformation.fct_tourney_games.name: fct_tourney_games
model.transformation.fct_tourney_games.description: Table de faits des matchs du tournoi NCAA. 1323 matchs, 1998–2018. 63 matchs par saison (bracket 64 équipes, pas de play-in games). Inclut seeds, analyse d'upsets et box score détaillé (nullable, depuis 2010).
model.transformation.fct_tourney_games.rawCode:
with compact as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_tourney_compact_results') }}
),
detailed as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_tourney_detailed_results') }}
),
seeds as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_tourney_seeds') }}
),
game_cities as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_game_cities') }}
),
seasons as (
    select season, day_zero from {{ ref('stg_seasons') }}
),
enriched as (
    select
        -- identifiant
        'T_' || cast(c.season as varchar) || '_' || cast(c.day_num as varchar) || '_' || cast(c.w_team_id as varchar) || '_' || cast(c.l_team_id as varchar) as game_id,
        'Tournament'                                                                            as game_type,

        -- calendrier
        c.season,
        c.day_num,
        (s.day_zero + interval (c.day_num) days)::date                                         as game_date,

        -- équipes
        c.w_team_id,
        c.l_team_id,

        -- scores
        c.w_score,
        c.l_score,
        c.w_score - c.l_score                                                                   as score_margin,
        c.w_score + c.l_score                                                                   as total_points,

        -- lieu
        c.w_loc,
        case c.w_loc
            when 'H' then 'Home'
            when 'A' then 'Away'
            else          'Neutral'
        end                                                                                     as game_location,

        -- overtime
        c.num_ot,
        c.num_ot > 0                                                                            as has_overtime,
        (c.w_score - c.l_score) <= 5                                                            as is_close_game,

        -- ville (nullable)
        gc.city_id,

        -- seeds
        ws.seed_raw                                                                             as w_seed_raw,
        ws.seed_region                                                                          as w_seed_region,
        ws.seed_number                                                                          as w_seed_number,
        ls.seed_raw                                                                             as l_seed_raw,
        ls.seed_region                                                                          as l_seed_region,
        ls.seed_number                                                                          as l_seed_number,

        -- upset analysis
        ws.seed_number > ls.seed_number                                                         as is_upset,
        ws.seed_number - ls.seed_number                                                         as seed_difference,

        -- box score winner (nullable)
        d.w_fgm,
        d.w_fga,
        round(d.w_fgm::double / nullif(d.w_fga, 0), 3)                                         as w_fg_pct,
        d.w_fgm3,
        d.w_fga3,
        round(d.w_fgm3::double / nullif(d.w_fga3, 0), 3)                                       as w_fg3_pct,
        d.w_ftm,
        d.w_fta,
        round(d.w_ftm::double / nullif(d.w_fta, 0), 3)                                         as w_ft_pct,
        coalesce(d.w_or, 0) + coalesce(d.w_dr, 0)                                              as w_reb,
        d.w_or,
        d.w_dr,
        d.w_ast,
        d.w_to,
        d.w_stl,
        d.w_blk,
        d.w_pf,

        -- box score loser (nullable)
        d.l_fgm,
        d.l_fga,
        round(d.l_fgm::double / nullif(d.l_fga, 0), 3)                                         as l_fg_pct,
        d.l_fgm3,
        d.l_fga3,
        round(d.l_fgm3::double / nullif(d.l_fga3, 0), 3)                                       as l_fg3_pct,
        d.l_ftm,
        d.l_fta,
        round(d.l_ftm::double / nullif(d.l_fta, 0), 3)                                         as l_ft_pct,
        coalesce(d.l_or, 0) + coalesce(d.l_dr, 0)                                              as l_reb,
        d.l_or,
        d.l_dr,
        d.l_ast,
        d.l_to,
        d.l_stl,
        d.l_blk,
        d.l_pf,

        d.season is not null                                                                    as has_box_score

    from compact c
    left join detailed d
        on  c.season    = d.season
        and c.day_num   = d.day_num
        and c.w_team_id = d.w_team_id
        and c.l_team_id = d.l_team_id
    left join seeds ws
        on  c.season    = ws.season
        and c.w_team_id = ws.team_id
    left join seeds ls
        on  c.season    = ls.season
        and c.l_team_id = ls.team_id
    left join game_cities gc
        on  c.season    = gc.season
        and c.day_num   = gc.day_num
        and c.w_team_id = gc.w_team_id
        and c.l_team_id = gc.l_team_id
    left join seasons s on c.season = s.season
)
select * from enriched

-- Une ligne par équipe et par match (saison régulière + tournoi NCAA),
-- vue depuis l'équipe : chaque match apparaît deux fois (gagnant puis perdant).
-- Table la plus souple pour Superset : filtrer sur une équipe suffit pour
-- obtenir tout son historique, sans union gagnant/perdant.

with regular as (
    select
        *,
        null::integer as w_seed_number,
        null::integer as l_seed_number,
        null::boolean as is_upset
    from {{ ref('fct_regular_season_games') }}
),

tourney as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_tourney_games') }}
),

all_games as (
    select * exclude (w_seed_number, l_seed_number, is_upset), w_seed_number, l_seed_number, is_upset
    from regular
    union all by name
    select * exclude (w_seed_raw, w_seed_region, l_seed_raw, l_seed_region, seed_difference)
    from tourney
),

-- point de vue du gagnant
winner_view as (
    select
        game_id,
        game_type,
        season,
        game_date,
        w_team_id                                           as team_id,
        l_team_id                                           as opponent_id,
        true                                                as is_win,
        w_score                                             as pts_for,
        l_score                                             as pts_against,
        case w_loc when 'H' then 'Home' when 'A' then 'Away' else 'Neutral' end
                                                            as team_location,
        num_ot,
        has_overtime,
        is_close_game,
        city_id,
        w_seed_number                                       as team_seed,
        l_seed_number                                       as opponent_seed,
        is_upset                                            as is_upset_win,
        case when game_type = 'Tournament' then false end   as is_upset_loss,
        has_box_score,
        w_fgm   as fgm,   w_fga   as fga,   w_fg_pct  as fg_pct,
        w_fgm3  as fgm3,  w_fga3  as fga3,  w_fg3_pct as fg3_pct,
        w_ftm   as ftm,   w_fta   as fta,   w_ft_pct  as ft_pct,
        w_or    as oreb,  w_dr    as dreb,
        w_ast   as ast,   w_to    as tov,   w_stl     as stl,
        w_blk   as blk,   w_pf    as pf,
        l_fg_pct  as opp_fg_pct,
        l_fg3_pct as opp_fg3_pct,
        l_or + l_dr as opp_reb,
        l_to      as opp_tov
    from all_games
),

-- point de vue du perdant
loser_view as (
    select
        game_id,
        game_type,
        season,
        game_date,
        l_team_id                                           as team_id,
        w_team_id                                           as opponent_id,
        false                                               as is_win,
        l_score                                             as pts_for,
        w_score                                             as pts_against,
        case w_loc when 'H' then 'Away' when 'A' then 'Home' else 'Neutral' end
                                                            as team_location,
        num_ot,
        has_overtime,
        is_close_game,
        city_id,
        l_seed_number                                       as team_seed,
        w_seed_number                                       as opponent_seed,
        case when game_type = 'Tournament' then false end   as is_upset_win,
        is_upset                                            as is_upset_loss,
        has_box_score,
        l_fgm   as fgm,   l_fga   as fga,   l_fg_pct  as fg_pct,
        l_fgm3  as fgm3,  l_fga3  as fga3,  l_fg3_pct as fg3_pct,
        l_ftm   as ftm,   l_fta   as fta,   l_ft_pct  as ft_pct,
        l_or    as oreb,  l_dr    as dreb,
        l_ast   as ast,   l_to    as tov,   l_stl     as stl,
        l_blk   as blk,   l_pf    as pf,
        w_fg_pct  as opp_fg_pct,
        w_fg3_pct as opp_fg3_pct,
        w_or + w_dr as opp_reb,
        w_to      as opp_tov
    from all_games
),

team_games as (
    select * from winner_view
    union all
    select * from loser_view
),

teams as (
    select team_id, team_name, team_state, team_state_iso from {{ ref('dim_teams') }}
),

seasons as (
    select season, season_label from {{ ref('dim_seasons') }}
),

cities as (
    select city_id, city, state from {{ ref('dim_cities') }}
),

final as (
    select
        -- identifiants
        g.game_id || '_' || cast(g.team_id as varchar)     as team_game_id,
        g.game_id,
        g.game_type,

        -- calendrier
        g.season,
        s.season_label,
        g.game_date,

        -- équipe et adversaire
        g.team_id,
        t.team_name,
        t.team_state,
        t.team_state_iso,
        g.opponent_id,
        o.team_name                                         as opponent_name,

        -- résultat
        g.is_win,
        case when g.is_win then 'W' else 'L' end            as result,
        g.pts_for,
        g.pts_against,
        g.pts_for - g.pts_against                           as pt_diff,
        g.team_location,
        g.num_ot,
        g.has_overtime,
        g.is_close_game,

        -- lieu du match (nullable : données villes à partir de 2010)
        c.city,
        c.state,
        case when c.state is not null then 'US-' || c.state end
                                                            as state_iso,

        -- tournoi (null en saison régulière)
        g.team_seed,
        g.opponent_seed,
        g.is_upset_win,
        g.is_upset_loss,

        -- box score de l'équipe (nullable : détaillé à partir de 2010)
        g.has_box_score,
        g.fgm,
        g.fga,
        g.fg_pct,
        g.fgm3,
        g.fga3,
        g.fg3_pct,
        g.ftm,
        g.fta,
        g.ft_pct,
        g.oreb,
        g.dreb,
        g.oreb + g.dreb                                     as reb,
        g.ast,
        g.tov,
        g.stl,
        g.blk,
        g.pf,

        -- quelques stats de l'adversaire
        g.opp_fg_pct,
        g.opp_fg3_pct,
        g.opp_reb,
        g.opp_tov

    from team_games g
    left join teams   t on g.team_id     = t.team_id
    left join teams   o on g.opponent_id = o.team_id
    left join seasons s on g.season      = s.season
    left join cities  c on g.city_id     = c.city_id
)

select * from final

        g.pts_against,
        g.pts_for - g.pts_against                           as pt_diff,
        g.team_location,
        g.num_ot,
        g.has_overtime,
        g.is_close_game,

        -- lieu du match (nullable : données villes à partir de 2010)
        c.city,
        c.state,
        case when c.state is not null then 'US-' || c.state end
                                                            as state_iso,

        -- tournoi (null en saison régulière)
        g.team_seed,
        g.opponent_seed,
        g.is_upset_win,
        g.is_upset_loss,

        -- box score de l'équipe (nullable : détaillé à partir de 2010)
        g.has_box_score,
        g.fgm,
        g.fga,
        g.fg_pct,
        g.fgm3,
        g.fga3,
        g.fg3_pct,
        g.ftm,
        g.fta,
        g.ft_pct,
        g.oreb,
        g.dreb,
        g.oreb + g.dreb                                     as reb,
        g.ast,
        g.tov,
        g.stl,
        g.blk,
        g.pf,

        -- quelques stats de l'adversaire
        g.opp_fg_pct,
        g.opp_fg3_pct,
        g.opp_reb,
        g.opp_tov

    from team_games g
    left join teams   t on g.team_id     = t.team_id
    left join teams   o on g.opponent_id = o.team_id
    left join seasons s on g.season      = s.season
    left join cities  c on g.city_id     = c.city_id
)

team_game_id.description: Identifiant unique de la ligne (PK) : game_id + '_' + team_id.

game_id.description: Identifiant du match (deux lignes par game_id). Préfixé 'T_' pour les matchs de tournoi.

game_type.description: Type de match : 'Regular' (saison régulière) ou 'Tournament' (tournoi NCAA).

season.description: Année de la saison (ex: 2019 pour la saison 2018-2019).

game_date.description: Date réelle du match. Colonne temporelle à utiliser dans Superset.

team_id.description: Identifiant de l'équipe (point de vue de la ligne).

team_state.description: Code état US de l'équipe (ex: CT), déduit de ses matchs à domicile. Null pour quelques équipes sans match localisé.

team_state_iso.description: Code ISO 3166-2:US de l'état de l'équipe (ex: US-CT). Pour le chart 'Country Map' de Superset.

is_win.description: Booléen : true si l'équipe a gagné ce match.

pt_diff.description: Écart de points signé (pts_for - pts_against) : positif en cas de victoire, négatif en cas de défaite.

team_location.description: Lieu du match du point de vue de l'équipe : 'Home' (à domicile), 'Away' (à l'extérieur) ou 'Neutral' (terrain neutre : environ la moitié des matchs de tournoi, les premiers tours se jouant souvent chez la tête de série).

has_overtime.description: Booléen : true si le match a eu au moins une prolongation.

is_close_game.description: Booléen : true si l'écart final est de 5 points ou moins.

city.description: Ville du match. Null avant 2010 (données villes disponibles à partir de la saison 2010).

state.description: Code état US de la ville du match (ex: TX). Null avant 2010.

state_iso.description: Code ISO 3166-2:US de l'état du match (ex: US-TX). Pour le chart 'Country Map'. Null avant 2010.

team_seed.description: Seed de l'équipe au tournoi (1 = meilleur, 16 = moins bien classé). Null en saison régulière.

opponent_seed.description: Seed de l'adversaire au tournoi. Null en saison régulière.

is_upset_win.description: Booléen (tournoi) : true si l'équipe a gagné contre un adversaire mieux classé (seed plus faible). Null en saison régulière.

is_upset_loss.description: Booléen (tournoi) : true si l'équipe a perdu contre un adversaire moins bien classé. Null en saison régulière.

has_box_score.description: Booléen : true si le box score détaillé est disponible (saisons 2010 et suivantes).

fgm.description: Tirs réussis (field goals made). Null sans box score.

fg_pct.description: Adresse aux tirs (fgm / fga), entre 0 et 1.

fg3_pct.description: Adresse à 3 points (fgm3 / fga3), entre 0 et 1.

ft_pct.description: Adresse aux lancers francs (ftm / fta), entre 0 et 1.

reb.description: Rebonds totaux (oreb + dreb). Null sans box score.

opp_fg_pct.description: Adresse aux tirs de l'adversaire, entre 0 et 1.

opp_fg3_pct.description: Adresse à 3 points de l'adversaire, entre 0 et 1.

opp_reb.description: Rebonds totaux de l'adversaire. Null sans box score.
